## Description {#details}

<p>Streaming object file generation interface.</p>


<p>This class provides an implementation of the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcstreamer">MCStreamer</a> interface which is suitable for use with the assembler backend. Specific object file formats are expected to subclass this interface to implement directives specific to that file format or custom semantics expected by the object writer implementation.</p>
